deleteAccountHelp.metaTitle: How to delete your account — playerz.bg
deleteAccountHelp.metaDescription: How to delete a playerz.bg account, what is deleted, and what the clubs keep.
deleteAccountHelp.title: Deleting your playerz.bg account
deleteAccountHelp.lead: You can delete your account yourself, at any time, from your Profile page. Here is how, and what happens to your data.

where.title: Where the button is
where.step1: Sign in to playerz.bg with the account you want to delete.
where.step2: Open Profile: from the bar at the bottom of your phone, or from the menu on the left on a computer.
where.step3: At the bottom of the page, under “Deleting your account”, press “Delete account”.
where.step4: Type DELETE and confirm. Your account is deleted at once, and you are signed out on every device.

upcoming.title: First: your upcoming bookings
upcoming.body: You can delete your account once you have no upcoming bookings. That way a club never loses a booking without notice.
upcoming.cancel: Cancel a booking you made from its page under Bookings.
upcoming.leave: Leave a game you were added to with “Leave the game”.
upcoming.wait: Once a club’s cancellation deadline has passed, the booking can no longer be cancelled in the app. You can then delete your account after it has been played.
upcoming.profile: Your Profile page shows which bookings are left and until when you can cancel them.

deleted.title: What is deleted
deleted.identity: your name, email address, phone number and picture;
deleted.sports: the sports and levels you set;
deleted.reviews: your reviews of venues (the venue’s rating is worked out again without them);
deleted.clubs: your club memberships and the notes clubs kept about you;
deleted.devices: the devices and sessions you signed in with.

kept.title: What stays, and why
kept.bookings: Your past and cancelled bookings stay with the clubs, without your name: their calendars and player lists show them as “Deleted user”. The clubs keep them because their statements and the platform fee are worked out from them. The same goes for your places on other players’ bookings.
kept.logs: Records of when a booking was made or cancelled stay in the clubs’ history, linked to the deleted account. They hold no email address, phone number or IP address of yours.
kept.credit: Unused credit at a club is lost and is not returned after the deletion. Your profile shows how much you have at each club before you delete your account.
kept.noShows: No-shows at a club, and any block on booking there online, do not go away with the account. They are kept for up to 90 days from each no-show, tied to a protected fingerprint of your email address and not to your name, so that a block cannot be dodged with a new account. If you make a new account with the same address, they move to it. The club’s notes and tags do not.

club.title: Club accounts
club.body: A club account can’t be deleted from the app. Write to us through the contact form and we will delete it.

export.title: A copy of your data
export.body: Before you delete your account, you can download a copy of your data: your profile, bookings, credit, notifications and devices. Profile → Privacy → “Download my data”. You get one file, in JSON format.

after.title: After deletion
after.body: Deletion can’t be undone. If you later sign in again with the same Google or Facebook account, you start with a new, empty account: the old one is not brought back.
after.facebook: If you signed in with Facebook, you can also remove playerz.bg’s access in your Facebook settings. That does not delete your playerz.bg account, though: delete it here.
